title: Planck's baseline column gives ΩΛ = 0.6847 ± 0.0073
summary: The same baseline column that carries the age lists a dark-energy density parameter of 0.6847 ± 0.0073.
body: Table 2 of Planck 2018 results VI, in the TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing column that the caption calls the baseline, lists ΩΛ = 0.6847 ± 0.0073 at 68 percent. This is a parameter of the base-ΛCDM fit. The paper's conclusions also say that dark energy is not understood at a fundamental level. That judgment is its own card. The matter density in the same fit is already stated on the existing big-bang card and is not repeated as a new result here.
